Initial release — comprehensive guide to major US government assistance programs.

- Covers SNAP, Medicaid, unemployment, LIHEAP, TANF, WIC, Section 8, Lifeline, SSDI, SSI, EITC, and more.
- Includes income thresholds, eligibility checklists, application steps, typical processing times, and tips to avoid denials.
- Provides screening tools and document tracking instructions.
- Special guidance for non-US users, with country-specific program substitutions and sources.
- Up-to-date with 2024 Federal Poverty Level guidelines.
